full_track.tags: K-Pop R&B ballad. Clean electric guitar plays a jazz-influenced chord progression with subtle chorus and reverb. A warm synth bass enters with a smooth, legato feel. The drums feature a crisp snare and a tight kick drum in a mid-tempo groove. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, melodic tenor with occasional breathy textures and falsetto ad-libs. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the guitar and the vocal performance. Key of E Major, 85 BPM.
